description: Read one article with all its commi in legal order (numeric commi first, others such as 2-bis after them). Each row has the unit urn, the comma label, the text, the Normattiva deep link and is_citable (true when the urn can be cited). Parameters: urn (the article urn, e.g. urn:nir:stato:legge:2000-07-27;212~art5). An unknown article gives no rows. Example: {"urn": "urn:nir:stato:legge:2000-07-27;212~art5"}.
